title: Hearty Sweet Canadian Tomato Gratin
description: A sweet and molten Canadian dish featuring confit-tomato and vegetable shortening, perfect for a cold winter night. This lacto-vegetarian-friendly recipe is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable shortening over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the confit-tomato and cook for 2 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, whisk together the flour and milk.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the shredded gruyere cheese until it is melted and smooth.
Season the cheese sauce with salt, black pepper, and chopped fresh thyme.
To assemble the gratin, transfer the tomato mixture to a hot stone plate.
Pour the cheese sauce over the top of the tomato mixture and smooth the top.
